question: EGLU is related to CDJR in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, WUDI is related to URBF. To which of the given options is QLXZ related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69a2832bc87cbf471d2bebb73ea5e3f22b2585b29caf9f9406f09cf2772a4d7d.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, EGLU is related to CDJR 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6dbbe275ec2fe275888f9bda45b616f072b396f98247712bef0170b437e40301.png] 

For, WUDI is related to URBF

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/43ce0addebf1f231071cc5456c78f08f7526c884fbee29f9bbe3c25194154f93.png] 

Similarly, for **QLXZ**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/17b4b462d78e3fc76a81d2fdc48743dde354c5faa2e91d8572ef9896c4f21d54.png] 

So, QLXZ will be related to **OIVW**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
